# Joshua Darron Phillips

> Founding engineer at RocketRide, an open-source AI runtime. I build the developer-facing surface in TypeScript, Python, and C++.

## About

Joshua Darron Phillips is a founding-team engineer at RocketRide AI Inc., based in California. He owns the developer-facing surface of an open-source MIT-licensed AI runtime: the TypeScript and Python SDKs, the MCP server, the VS Code extension, and the workshop tooling. He also built Pulsar, a market intelligence agent running internally across finance, HR, and marketing at RocketRide, which launches as a featured app on RocketRide Cloud. He works in TypeScript, Python, and C++, and writes about what he builds.

## Current Role

- Founding Engineer at RocketRide AI Inc. (2026 - Present, San Francisco, CA)
- Owns the developer-facing surface: TypeScript SDK, Python SDK, MCP server, VS Code extension, workshop tooling
- Built Pulsar, the internal market intelligence agent launching as a featured app on RocketRide Cloud
